items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Ann Cook, remember the night we recorded Ann Cook? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, sir.

ctx.x: Oh, he used to play with John Casimir Brass Band. Used to be a porter over there. Rogers. Rogers, that's right. That's right. Curtis Rogers. That's right. He was a custodian at the City Hall.
And Ann Cook, remember the night we recorded Ann Cook?
